source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Against an attack on a mixed-Toughness Aquila Kill Team, take the Toughness from the largest group of models sharing that characteristic. Resolve ties in favour of the highest tied value. Keep using that value for [Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) until the attacking models finish their attacks. For [Embarking](vsdata:core-rule/embarking), each Gravis Veteran uses two model spaces and can ride in TRANSPORTS that accept comparable models from other units, even though the Aquila Kill Team lacks the GRAVIS keyword.
